title: E-FRC-0103: the classical color group Sigma(648), whose links are three tones and a coin direction, freezes under...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0103 in the gauge arena: the classical color group Sigma(648), whose links are three tones and a coin direction, freezes under the Wilson action long before the couplings where hadrons are measured, but with a $\operatorname{Re} \operatorname{Tr} U^2$ term it stays unfrozen, deconfines at $N_t = 4$, and there gives the same Creutz ratios as SU(3) at its $N_t = 4$ transition, so at that spacing SU(3) needs no golden-ratio element.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
